card.name: The word emissions in climate text
card.fires_on: The word "emissions" (or its start, E-missions) in climate and pollution writing, especially in report titles and phrases like emissions targets, caps and reduction.

modes.label: Emissions targets and caps
modes.description: The word "emissions" before nouns like targets, cap, reduction in climate policy text.
modes.example: 42 industrialized countries submitted “economy-wide”<< emissions>> targets for 2020.
